data.subject: Public-record research for JACOBS
data.body:
Hi,

JACOBS ASSET MANAGEMENT, LLC's most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in AVBH, MYFW, and CBK.

On August 27, 2026, AVBH entered into a material definitive agreement, according to its Form 8-K Item 1.01 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1443575/000143774926029104/avbh20260429_8k.htm).

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records—permits, agendas, call reports, and filings—with every claim cited.

May I send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot? Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
